learning_outcomes.text: Gaining theoretical overview on ways of alternative energy sources use and basics of AES application design.

syllabus_topics: Solar thermal systems - design and balancing
Solar systems components and their design
Sources of low potential heat for heat pumps (air, water, ground, waste heat)
Design of low potential heat sources
Efficiency and thermal output of solar collector
Dimensioning of solar collector area for water heating systems
Heat pump cycle in diagramm pressure-enthalpy
Dimensioning of low-potential heat sources for heat pumps (ground bore holes and flat collectors, wells, waste air)
Design of heat pump for heating (heat load, heating water temperature)
bibliography: Matuška, T.: Sešit projektanta - Solární tepelné soustavy, STP 2009.
Matuška, T.: Alternativní zdroje energie, ČVUT 2010. Učební podklady na internetu.
degree: Oferta Erasmus+ en inglés de la Fac. de Ingeniería Mecánica (sin plan de grado atado)
